scripts.text:
[Zac]
I am the oldest and strongest of the 4 brothers that makes all the newer hats. You will need to bring me the correct items for each hat, so I can make them.
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
我是制作所有新款帽子的四兄弟中最年长、最强壮的一个。你需要为我带来制作每顶帽子所需的正确材料，我才能为你制作。

scripts.text:
[Zac]
I provide 1 hat and my brothers provides the other 5.
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
我负责制作1种帽子，我的兄弟们负责制作另外5种。

scripts.text: Join
scripts.translation: 加入

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 资讯

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Zac]
What hat do you want me to make?
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
你想让我制作什么帽子？

scripts.text: Bongun Hat
scripts.translation: 妖道帽

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Let me check the items you have brought here.
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
让我检查一下你带来的物品。

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Wow!! Well done! Finally you have gathered all items needed! We will make the Bongun Hat for you right away. Please Wait a Moment.
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
哇！！干得漂亮！你终于集齐了所有需要的物品！我们马上为你制作妖道帽。请稍候。

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Tah Dah! ^FF0000Bongun Hat^000000...! Please Take it!
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
当当！^FF0000妖道帽^000000……！请收下吧！

scripts.text:
[Zac]
I liked that, I look forward to making more. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
我很喜欢，期待制作更多。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Oh, dear. You need 10 Amulets...
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
哦，天哪。你需要10个护身符……

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Oh, dear. You need 1 Cobaltblue Dyestuffs...
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
哦，天哪。你需要1个钴蓝色染料……

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Oh, dear. You need 1 Munak Hat...
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
哦，天哪。你需要1个僵尸帽……

scripts.text:
[Zac]
Which hat materials do you wish to know?
scripts.translation:
[扎克]
你想了解哪种帽子的材料？

scripts.translation:
